version.mechanism_text: When the prior close remains above SMA(200), a two-session decline of at least one ATR reflects temporary daily-scale price pressure rather than a broken long-term trend. Buying the next daily open, holding overnight, and exiting at a 0.75 ATR profit limit or the fifth session close should earn repeatable net returns across gold, Nasdaq and S&P 500 after the user-specified fee.

allowed_changes: one fixed cross-asset rule: previous close above trailing SMA(200) and the two-session close-to-close decline is at least 1.00 times ATR(14)
enter at the next real daily open, with no same-session exit allowed
from the second held asset session, exit at entry open plus 0.75 times the frozen T-1 ATR when daily high reaches it; otherwise exit at the fifth held session close
standalone 100% sleeve runs for gold_cny, nasdaq and sp500 plus one fixed one-third-per-asset combined run
matched pullback controls that remove only the SMA(200) trend gate, a CNY demand-cash control and one preregistered 0.05% adverse-slippage execution stress
on a combined-calendar date with no real bar for an already-held asset, carry its last valid close for valuation only; do not advance its holding-session counter or test its profit limit
forbidden_changes: reading execution-session high, low or close before the opening buy decision
allowing a same-session take-profit exit on the entry bar
any SMA, ATR, pullback, take-profit or holding-period grid or post-result threshold change
using synthetic OHLC rows or close-only fallback rows as real OHLC
asset-specific parameters or dropping a weak gold, Nasdaq or S&P 500 component
adding RSI, MACD, volume, calendar or another factor after viewing this result
adding a stop-loss or changing the five-session liquidation rule
shorting, borrowing, financing, leverage, negative target weights, gross exposure above 100% or negative end-of-day cash
changing the user-specified 0.005% per-fill fee or hiding the preregistered slippage stress
representing index OHLC execution as directly investable product evidence
omitting an open position from portfolio value merely because another market has a session on that date

shared_rules.entry: buy current session real open after the T-1 close signal passes
shared_rules.exit: no entry-day exit; from held session 2 sell at entry open + 0.75 * frozen T-1 ATR if daily high reaches it, otherwise sell held session 5 close
shared_rules.trend_rule: previous close > mean of the 200 closes ending at previous close
